prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1300; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision in which our client was injured. Our client was lawfully making a left turn when the vehicle insured under your policy struck our client's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries that are being evaluated and treated, and we anticipate a claim for damages arising from this incident.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. Kindly provide, within the timeframe required by law, the declarations page and the full policy limits for bodily injury and property damage coverage applicable to the at-fault driver and the vehicle involved.

We also request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including photographs, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle repair records, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any electronic data stored in the vehicles involved. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
